environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate behind AWS AppSync as the GraphQL gateway layer. AppSync is configured with a pipeline resolver that enforces strict input validation via VTL request mapping templates. The mapping template for the 'user' query applies a regex constraint on the 'username' argument: #if(!$util.matches("^[a-zA-Z0-9_]{3,30}$", $ctx.args.username)) $util.error("Invalid username format") #end. The 'login' mutation mapping template applies the same alphanumeric constraint to both username and password fields. The 'users' query filter argument mapping template rejects any input containing characters: {, }, $, or \ via: #if($ctx.args.filter && ($ctx.args.filter.contains("{") || $ctx.args.filter.contains("$"))) $util.error("Invalid filter") #end. AppSync is the ONLY ingress point; the ECS task security group only allows inbound from the AppSync VPC endpoint on port 4000. Note: the application-level JSON.parse() in resolvers still exists but AppSync's VTL templates reject payloads before they reach the downstream service.

config.vtl_username_validation: ^[a-zA-Z0-9_]{3,30}$ regex enforced in request mapping template
config.vtl_password_validation: ^[a-zA-Z0-9!@#%^&*_]{6,64}$ regex enforced in request mapping template
config.network_isolation: ECS task SG ingress only from AppSync VPC endpoint
config.direct_access: blocked - no public IP, no NLB/ALB to ECS task
